notes.title: Clan Dungeon 2nd Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/577c9b0fae32745a39837055ad3ecbc58125db56.png

As the Black Dragons Clan rises in power, they extend their control deeper into the land. The Shaolin and Sacred Flower clans, originally thought to be impenetrable, have been compromised. As this threat extends beyond individual clans, a temporary alliance has been made, to make all clan dungeons available to any willing to take on the Black Dragons. In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons for both the Shaolin and Sacred Flower, you can participate in to obtain materials to create a new set of powerful relics, in addition to the armor sets and clan skills already available.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.


Level Requirement: 230+
Solo or four players parties can enter the dungeon.
You can choose between Normal and Hard (True) dungeons.
Each dungeon can be entered once per day, for a total of 4 entries. (Solo: Normal/True, Party: Normal/True)
Create New Equipment.


New Clan Dungeon Entrances
To ensure that every clan dungeon can be accessed by any clan, the dungeon entrances have been move to the Highlands of Bamboo Village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/83533765cbf023e26d7503dd41733112066e752e.png

Wu-Tang Dungeon
Enter the Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b82fcd0a1857e3ce28db3316ecbefc825c4e8f37.png

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

Heavenly Demon Dungeon
Enter Heavenly Demon Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter True Heavenly Demon Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c6b9fcd59fabc8531b83966844a39461cc0b17bf.png

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

Shaolin Dungeon
Enter the Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0149fbc650d2586bb3a0a47d557f583f1e530f90.png

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

Sacred Flower Dungeon
Enter the Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7d95ecea76292a3bc47be5acdf5d426ff21e27a9.png

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

Rewards
You can receive additional contribution rewards when you party up with 4 players. The type of rewards is differentiated between Normal and True difficulty. Rewards will be distributed according to who has dealt the most damage to the boss monster. (Same system as East & West Temple.) For a limited time, True difficulty dungeons will give 1 extra Clan Additional Reward Box for both Solo and Party Dungeons.

The reward UI can be accessed by clicking the green gift box on the right-hand side of your screen.

notes.title: Qingdao 1st Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8e5f4afd6136867578c1edf58f55507814b97a84.png

Qingdao is a village of night, the town of lust and decadence. The village is under the control of the Black Dragon Clan, so the White and Black clan can not easily unleash their momentum.

When dusk falls in the town, the market street becomes sleepless and chaotic due to merchants, thugs, thieves, and gamblers. Rumor has it that the money and treasure collected from the black market and casino are equivalent to Clan of Golden Coins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/12b00250ef8b34f7e8ffff0e5b3905c322982f66.png

The entrance of Qingdao gateway is located in Hefei near the Strolling Valley. There are several NPCs in front of the gate who can provide various information about Qingdao.

Combat is possible in Qingdao and PvP is encouraged. Low ranks should be aware of the invasions from other players.

White Cloud and Black Cloud Basin
The town is divided into two villages across from a memorial tower called the Ghiryu Tower. Warriors on Black Cloud and White Cloud Basin villages must build up their strength to seize the opposite side.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4f70b2b384a300505960d1aa42c2a1750523c9e2.png

Qingdao Deviants
Emperor Lei, the ruler of the Black Dragons Clan has gone missing. In his wake, the Black Dragon retainers, The Five Heroes From Darkness have free reign to rule over Qingdao. The Five Heroes from Darkness are composed of Magi, the Black Widows Blood, Kwakil, the Shadowless Sword, Hansung, the Flaming Steel Prince, Pyoje, the Hurrican Sword, and Chaewon, the Double-edge Fangs. The strength of deviant evil forces in Qingdao is no joke! Countless warriors came to challenge the deviants in the name of freedom, but none of them have survived to tell the tale.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7e25c4641d5000fa1e7c6abdcc11644bc8b0e169.png

Ghiryu Tower
Ghiryu Tower is the symbol of true warlords. Each floor has vicious and fearsome deviants lie in wait. The gate into Ghiryu Tower will be open sometime in the near future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/665fede115484a4b8d113b48358d779ec3a341ef.png

New Road to Enlightenment and Heroic (Daily) Quests
Talk to Yang Wuqi in Hefei to lead you into your journey to liberating Qingdao from the clutches of the Black Dragons clan and their legion of followers through an assortment of new quests. The villagers need your help and are prepared to reward you handsomely for your efforts!

Create New Items and Increase Your Strength
Gather material items from helping villagers in quests and slaying members of the Black Dragons Clan to create an assortment of new items that will help you recruit Comrades that will aid you in battle, or build Weapons and Armor to give you the strength to stand over your enemies!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/46175e37537a4620d4a4ebb870ac332f13380349.png

Swords of the Dragon Warlord - The Book of White Dragon Spirits
For the past few decades, a great number of skilled warriors have been in search of 2 legendary artifacts called, Nine Dragon Jade Circle and Swords of the Dragon Warlords, scouring the land, whenever a clue presents itself.

During their never-ending journey, many warriors from various clans have learned and improved their kung-fu skills exponentially by defeating evil deviants and members of the rival clans in their way.

The legend of the Swords of The Dragon Warlords is proven by renowned archaeologists over numerous years showing evidence that this artifact is more than just a myth.

The legendary Nine Dragon Jade Circle was an accessory, which belonged to the Thunder Emperor, a great legendary warrior. He carved his ultimate kung-fu techniques on the surface of a circle accessory and scattered it's 9 pieces before heading out to the final battle of the War of Nine Dragons.

On the other hand, the tale of the Swords of the Dragon Warlords tells of how the swords were magically forged using 5 sacred elements, and the spirits of 5 Dragons sealed within. According to legend, those who acquire all 5 swords shall unlock the secret passage of the Treasure of the Dragon Warlord, which is has been said to be the key to achieve the status of Overlord of the Mighty Dragons.

The Thunder Emperor had the chance to gain the Black Dragon Warlord Sword, one of the 5 legendary swords, and has achieved Super Metamorphosis, leaving a bloodbath in his wake.

After countless years of searching, a secret room has been discovered in Potala Palace, during their most recent clan battle. What was so important in about the tiny room, that it had been sealed for decades? Even the elders and high councils of the palace had no idea of its existence. Within the dusty room lay nothing, but an old bookshelf containing the legendary Book of White Dragon Spirits. This was one of the greatest discoveries of the century, proving the story of the Swords of the Dragon Warlords was more than just an ancient myth.

Without hesitation, the leaders of well-established clans rushed to Potala Palace in Tibet, in order to conduct an expedition to unlock and obtain the secrets of the Book of White Dragon Spirits. Countless souls perished during their investigation, but nothing could stop them from acquiring the precious book, as they paved the roads to Potala Palace with blood.

The strongest 6 clans were no exception but realized that the battle over the legendary artifacts must be halted before any further expeditions could be conducted. Ultimately, the leaders of the 6 clans had an official meeting and came to an agreement to forge 6 copies of the Book of White Dragon Spirits, to be passed down to the successors of each clan head, putting an end to the surrounding chaos.

After the forgeries of the Book of White Dragon Spirits were handed to the leader of each clan, leading scholars and archaeologists are gathered to decode the ancient text and reveal the path to become the Overlord of the Mighty Dragons.

The decoding process was a very tedious and complicated process, uncovering the meaning of only 3 sentences thus far:

Crimson Fog
"Everywhere is filled with blood, smoke, fog, and corpses..."

Scattering Souls
"Difficult to perform techniques by scattering one's vital energy."

Silent Fortress
"There is no safe zone due to the surrounding delicate formations."

Hainan Location
Hainan Island is located on the southern edge of China.
You can move only if you have an item called Hainan Teleport Scroll, which will teleport you to a random spot on the island.
You can acquire the scroll from the Hainan Survivor, Masked Man in Hefei.
The only way to leave the island is to ride on a boat at the shoreline to Liaodong. However, please notice that once you leave, you will have to use another Hainan Teleport Scroll to return.

Trace of Guardian

===============

Patch Notes 159 for February 12, 2019
The following release notes contain information about the update.

Storm vs. Storm Update
Storm vs. Storm (SvS) is a power struggle between Hero Bands that occur every week, where players attempt to capture Stone Pillars to gain rewards.

The first battle will begin on Saturday, February 16, 2019, at 9:00 AM PST.

Starting Storm vs. Storm

Locate the Storm vs. Storm menu by accessing the SvS tab of the F11 menu.
Storm vs. Storm will only be held at the Fortress of Majesty in Hangzhou.
Only the Band Master can request and cancel the SvS Challenge. Up to 50 Hero Bands can participate per one SvS.
SvS Registration Period: Between the end of the previous battle and one week before the next one begins. (Unable to register once the SvS has already started.)
The "Waiting Area" button will automatically appear 30 minutes before the start of the upcoming Storm vs. Storm. "Waiting Area" button can be found in the F11menu → Storm vs. Storm tab. Click the button to move to the Fortress waiting area. The function is available until the end of Storm vs. Storm.
Health Potions, Huatuo Panacea, and Lightfoot are prohibited during the battle. Recovery skills, continuous recovery potions, and Siphon Panacea can be used.
There is no death or combat penalty, and you are allowed to attack members from the same clan.

Storm vs. Storm Progress

At the beginning of Storm vs. Storm, all Stone Pillars located in the Fortress are uncaptured and ready to occupied. A total of 10 Stone Pillars protected by Fortress Guard DNPCs
Deviants will appear a total of 10 times to protect each Stone Pillar.  As time goes by, more powerful deviants will emerge, so it is recommended to defeat them.
Characters who died during Storm vs. Storm can revive back to the waiting area with Impervious time effect of 30 seconds. The Impervious time effect is reduced when you use the Pillar to teleport.

Storm vs. Storm Rewards

The Hero Band with the most amount of Stone Pillar occupied will be declared as Lord of the Fortress and will receive trade/sell taxes on all items in Zhengzhou, Shi Zhang, Jinan, Datong, Nanchang, Tibet, Hangzhou, Liaodong, Hefei, The Cave of the Conqueror, Loulan, North Sea, and Kunlun.
The tax rate gain is base on how many Stone Pillar captured. (1 Stone Pillar = 10% Tax Rate)
The tax rate accumulation will begin from the time of the end of SvS and can only be withdrawn by the Hero Band Master.

Ended Lunar New Year Event

Removed 2019 letters from dungeon drops.
Removed Lunar New Year content from the Festival Merchant, Seo Hwarang NPC resource and trade list.
The Golden Pig Summoning Spirit sale has ended.
*]Removed winter themed decoration in Hefei Marketplace.

Black vs. White War
Black vs. White war schedule has changed. The new schedule is every Thursday at 20:00 and Sunday at 11:00 server time.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an exploit where the same type relic can be equipped simultaneously.
Fixed an issue where skills cannot be used after being revived by a party member.
Fixed an issue where skills can gain experience points while attacking stands.
Fixed a bug where the healer formation skill cooldown can be canceled.
Fixed the description of Blood Mushroom skill on Blood Sorcerer Crimson weapons.
Abnormal transition progress through data exchange during client execution is corrected.

Improvements

Improved the Character (C) window where it closes while character bag is open.
Stats tooltip between Character (C) window and Character summary window is now the same.

Miscellaneous

The Hero Band and Master & Disciple list have been reset.
Infinite Dungeon ranking have been reset, and points distributed to the top 50.

notes.title: Update: Costume Gallery
notes.notes:
In this update, you will be able to register Costumes into your Costume Gallery, which can be accessed via F11, where you can change, unequip, and add additional stats to all of your Costumes.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/1b64fb6b853df2e1c6ba5acd910a63780938977c.png

Costume Gallery Registration

In order to register a Costume into your Costume Gallery, you will need to purchase slots using in-game gold.
You can purchase a maximum of 6 Gallery slots using gold, then for slots 7 through 50, you will need to use Costume Slot Ticket, which can be purchased in our Marketplace.
To Register a Costume, simply right click on the Costume you wish to register in your inventory.
The icon for the selected deco will appear in the Costume Registration and Extraction section.
Upon clicking the Register button, you will be asked to confirm registration of your Costume into the Costume Gallery.
Keep in mind that once you register a Costume, it will be deleted from your inventory and will be permanently registered.
Additionally, timed Costumes cannot be registered to your Costume Gallery.

Cost of Costume Gallery Slots
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/8524403cd1991e9df42db7daabad5a93511f348e.png

Potential Abilities and Extraction

In the Costume Gallery system, you will be able to add Potential Abilities, or stats, to your Costume, by clicking on the Fabric icon in the Ability section.
Ability slots are ranked 1 - 5 with the first slot being Rank 1, and the last slot being Rank 5.
To unlock Ability slots, you will need to use Fabrics, which can be gained through Costume Extraction, by right clicking a Costume in your Inventory and clicking the Extract button in the Costume Registration and Extraction section of your Costume Gallery UI.
Keep in mind that Clan, timed, or opposite gender Costumes cannot be entered for Extraction.

Fabric Cost for Potential Ability Ranks
